page.layout: One printed title page on the right, centred; at the left edge a fragment of the neighbouring page with running text in narrow columns (margin of another page, not transcribed as main text).
page.notes: The left-hand strip shows fragments of text from the facing page (e.g. "icitur", "l dif.", "tarch", "Ari-", "tatem", "bilem"); these are show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Ornamental rules separate the imprint from the title lines. The "&" at the end of the imperfectio line is as printed.
